description: (needs account token) Returns a payment link that turns on email for a site's own domain (a main inbox such as hello@yourdomain.com, €5 / $5 a month, including VAT in the EU). The account holder opens and pays the link. After payment the inbox is set up. A saved card is not charged. The site needs an active domain first.

address.description: The part before the @ of the main inbox, e.g. "hello". Default hello.

site.description: The address of the site whose domain gets email, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: get_email_checkout_link
title: Get email checkout link
